title: Manifest
description: The manifest of a module, manifest.yaml at the root of its folder: the format version the module is written in, its ID and version, what it is called and teaches, whom it is for, the bands of its difficulty scale, its languages, the anchor skills it builds on, the settings of its canvas, its authors and its license, and the templates of the rungs of its hint ladder. Every field is open, since the learner's app shows them.

module_format_version.description: The version of the module format the module is written in, "0.1": the module is checked, built and run by it. It stands at the root of the manifest in every version of the format, so that a reader finds it before it knows which schemas to read the module by.

title.description: What the module is called, in its explanation language.

age_categories.description: The age categories that the module suits. The platform offers the module only to learners in one of them.

grades.description: The school grades that the module is written for. A module that names them asks the learner's grade, and the answer may be one it does not name. Unlike the age categories, grades close nothing: the module and its skills stay open to a learner of any grade.

audience.description: Whom the module is for: its age categories and, for a module written for school grades, those grades.

id.description: The band's ID, by which a task names it.

title.description: What the band is called, in the module's explanation language: Grades 1–2.

grades.description: The school grades the band's tasks are written for, in a module that names grades: a learner of one of them starts in this band.

bands.description: The bands of the module's difficulty scale, from the easiest: each task names its band and a difficulty from 1 to 5 within it. A module with tasks has them.

explanation.description: The explanation language: the one language in which the module explains and the tutor speaks with the learner. Every text of the module is in it, except the material of a language module, which is in its target language.

target.description: The target language: the one that a language module teaches. Other modules have none.

dependencies.description: The anchor skills of the shared taxonomy that the module's skills need: exactly those that its skill graph names as prerequisites. A module whose skills need none leaves this field out.

digit_height.description: The height in px that a digit or a letter of the learner's writing has on the crop that goes to be read: 32 unless given.

canvas.description: The settings of the module's canvas, the same for each of its tasks.

name.description: The name of an author: a person or an organization.

license.description: The license of the module's content: Apache-2.0 for an official module.

rung_templates.description: The templates of rungs 1 and 2 of the hint ladder, in order, in the module's explanation language: what the learner reads after a wrong answer when the tutor's question did not come or did not pass its checks, and neither a trap text nor a trap's advice fits. A module with an item with a verdict has them.
